PIM.Title: Holdings
PIM.TickConfirm: Collect income and roll events for all holdings?
PIM.SellConfirm: Sell this holding? Fund, sale value and balances are paid to owners by share.
PIM.Name: Name
PIM.SeasonsHint: Season:multiplier, e.g. Fall:2;Winter:0.3 (needs Simple Calendar seasons).
PIM.Notice: Holdings: {events} event(s), {builds} building(s) ready, {collect} to collect.
PIM.NewEvent: {name}: new event "{title}". Attend it before the deadline or lose the chance!
PIM.Sold: {name}: sold. {amount} paid out to the owners.

Hint.owners: Share % of each actor. What is not assigned goes to the holding fund (pays for buildings and hiring).
Hint.stats: Each point adds 'per point' income every period. Max 0 = unlimited.
Hint.units: Garrison, workers... Players hire (+) from the fund. Net per unit = income − upkeep.
Hint.upgrades: Offered by the GM. Effects: Morale+5;Guards+2 (stat or unit names).
Hint.events: Amount / missed: formulas (gain or loss). Effects: Morale+5;Guards-2. Condition: Morale<30;Fund>100. Season: Fall,Summer. Weight: odds vs others. Deadline: periods to attend.

S.languageHint: Select language for Passive Income MGK (Auto follows Foundry language).
S.autoHint: Each elapsed period collects income and rolls events.
S.currencyPathHint: e.g. system.currency.gp. Empty = collect is only announced in chat.
S.coinsHint: Overrides the path above. Format label=path:ratio;... with the base unit at ratio 1, e.g. gp=system.currency.gp:1;sp=system.currency.sp:0.1;cp=system.currency.cp:0.01

PIM.SearchActor: Search actor or drop from sidebar...
PIM.BlankDesc: Start with a clean slate and configure every detail yourself.
PIM.NoGM: A GM must be online for this action.
PIM.NoEvents: No eligible event (check conditions and season).
PIM.OverShare: Shares added up to more than 100%: scaled down.
PIM.NoOwners: No owners yet. Edit the holding to assign actors.
PIM.NoCurrencyPath: Cannot collect: no currency path or coin denominations configured.
PIM.UnknownName: Unknown stat or unit in conditions/effects: {names}
PIM.PeriodsSkipped: Skipped {count} periods due to a large time jump.
